detail: Attended the Catholic secondary school in Edegem, near Antwerp; Humo profiled him in 2010 among the school's 'class of '88' (Dutch-language Wikipedia).
Studied law for two years before switching to history.

qualification: Licentiate in History (licentiaat geschiedenis, master's-level degree)
detail: Began his history studies at UFSIA (Sint-Ignatius University Centre, Antwerp) and graduated from KU Leuven in 1995 with a thesis on the revival of Flemish-nationalist party politics in the Antwerp district, 1949–1965. As a student he was a member of the liberal LVSV and the Catholic student union KVHV in Antwerp and Leuven and edited the KVHV magazines Tegenstroom and Ons Leven.
Obtained the upper-secondary teaching qualification the year after his licentiate.
Began a doctoral thesis while working as a research assistant, and abandoned it in 2002 to devote himself fully to politics.
